entities.summary: Kim Hyowŏn was a Korean philosopher and politician during the Joseon period. A Neo-Confucian scholar, his art name was Sŏngam, and his courtesy name was Inbaek. He was a leader of the Easterners faction, born into the Seonsan Kim clan.
